text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Absenteeism rate at small companies falls to 5.1 percent in 1996 from 5.5 percent the year before.
Krasnapolsky hotel buys the five star Lord Charles hotel in South Africa, its first buy outside of Amsterdam.
Martinair, the charter airline company jointly owned by KLM and Nedlloyd, sees strong recovery after big 1996 profits drop.
Victims of the trade in women should be better socially, financially and legally supported, EU Justice and Home Affairs ministers decide at a meeting in the Hague.
Boskalis backs the idea of an extension to Amsterdam's Schiphol airport into the North Sea.
Wall Street market seen nervous over inflation, awaiting U.S. economic figures this week.
